notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.50 — Replaced the small elapsed-time labels with two centred, seconds-updating digital stopwatches on each candidate card: THIS STEP and OVERALL. Both appear again prominently when a candidate's checklist is expanded, and the current step's own elapsed stopwatch is displayed beside its checkbox. Every successful step advancement permanently freezes that step's duration and automatically starts a NEW 00:00:00 stopwatch on the next unfinished step; historical steps completed before stopwatch tracking cannot have fabricated times. For existing active candidates, the current step starts at zero when this version begins tracking it. The OVERALL stopwatch continues from the genuine start timestamp already recorded in the Hub, or shows a neutral minimum age when only a later precise milestone survives. All watches use existing green/orange/red advisory windows, update every second without rerendering or moving candidates, and survive Hub restarts on the same Windows device. No manual date/time setup, extra categories, or changes to official MBL records.
